metadata.null_method: Uniform type permutation among all identities, same mapping at every sample; independent permutations per seed, equal-seed aggregate. Preserves trajectory autocorrelation. Per-sample schooling-composition analytic null also reported.
metadata.rank_definition: (midrank-1)/(number present-1), ties averaged; schooling rank among state-0 fish, all rank among all fish.
metadata.regression: OLS separately per seed, Slow reference. Primary simple signed deficit + type; sensitivity adds positive deficit hinge and cycle phase. Descriptive conditional association, no independent fish-time errors.
metadata.phase_definition: Sampled whole-shoal median upward crossing of 1 BL; rest below 1 BL outside events, rise from upward crossing to first onset before next downcrossing, descent after event end to next downcrossing; events take precedence; remaining above-threshold samples unclassified.
metadata.horizontal_definition: Schooling circular centroid, minimum-image xy offsets. Front/side and compact radius only if both minimal covering arcs <= half-period, both circular strengths >0.2, horizontal mean-heading norm >=0.2, and >24 schooling fish. Toroidal radius only requires circular strength >0.2 and >24 schooling fish.
metadata.event_definition: Canonical gap=1 s; start>=300 and end<=T-2. Shares averaged equally per event within seed. Earliest tied releasers split weight; first10 distinct and first0.5 s sensitivity. Ready misses use last saved sample at/before onset and completed event membership.
